steps.content: (Scene Change: Conference Room)

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The routine examination is finished. Sinner Jasmine is in good health overall, and all her previous injuries have healed completely. The only side effect is her heightened sensitivity to Mania, which sharpens her environmental perception in high-stimulation settings.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: However, her mental state shows unusual instability. Her cognitive coherence falls well below standard Sinner thresholds. Currently, she's unable to maintain meaningful external communication or fully regulate her own actions.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Multiple interrogation sessions have yielded nothing. Her memory is fragmented, her speech incoherent. Even if you went personally, Chief ${PlayerName}, the results would be the same.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Such cases are rare in DisCity. We have not yet determined the cause.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Not yet determined the cause...?

steps.speaker: Fraser Ambassador
steps.content: The trigger of her mental disorder is the weapon she has been carrying. That's why Advisor Campbell replaced that pair of blades with props for her stage performance, to prevent further harm.

steps.speaker: Fraser Ambassador
steps.content: The weapon has already been secured and transferred to DisCity for research, with additional enhanced Aurum Secretum restrictions in place.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes, it has been sent to the Ring Research Institute.

steps.speaker: Fraser Ambassador
steps.content: They must've said it's been sent to the Ring Research Institute. But according to our intelligence, that weapon actually ended up in FAC's hands.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...You're not doubting that we sealed the intelligence again, are you?
Look at that, now it's playing the victim.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not so easily tricked into questioning FAC, and I trust that all allied departments will conduct a professional and fair investigation of that suspicious weapon, and will <color=#fb9259>openly and honestly share all reports with me</color> afterward.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...Understood. I will make your expectations clear to them.
You find it somewhat amusing to tease Schorl. When things calm down, you plan to pry for more information.
But for now, these Outlanders strike you as far more suspicious than anyone else.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Jasmine wasn't initially part of our delegation. We came across her in WhiteSands. Though her health was fragile, she was quite determined to accompany us to DisCity. I believe this city holds special significance for her.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Her passion moved me deeply, so I extended the invitation myself. To think such an accident would follow...

Fraser has poured so much effort into every detail—dressing her up, teaching her to dance, placing her center stage at the Great Expo to draw everyone's attention. They couldn't have gone to such lengths just to sell her off at auction.
[Flashback: Duo Dance CG]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...If they went to all this trouble, the least I can do is play along and see what they're really after.
A faint, almost imperceptible current of electricity whispers past, and the little triangle beside you seems to change its tone.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Heh, your positivity is surely refreshing. This reminds me of something... Would you be interested in trying a new technology under development? One that could... provide deeper insight into Sinners.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Let's call it... Codename LINK for now.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This specialized technology was created for Sinners whose minds are severely corrupted by Mania, becoming chaotic and fragmented after prolonged contact. But ironically, that same corruption makes possible a technology that can resonate with them through Mania.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: That's right. I'm referring to your <color=#fb9259>shackles</color>.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Based on our extended observation and research, we believe your mental resilience now meets the requirements for extensive Mania field exposure. You should be able to connect with the target Sinner's consciousness and achieve deeper synchronization.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: When that happens, the two of you will share one consciousness, including memories, emotions, personality traits, and even thoughts—if they still exist. You can also guide and manipulate them to extract the intelligence you need.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Therefore, the greater a Sinner's psychological collapse, the deeper you can access their consciousness for intelligence extraction.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You're suggesting that Jasmine meets the requirements for LINK.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Oh but of course, this technology isn't fully developed yet, so we strongly advise against current usage. Entering a fragmented mind poses significant risks, and your safety remains our primary concern.

steps.speaker: Option
options: ...You sure seem excited to try it out on me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Otherwise you wouldn't even have brought it up at a time like this.
Seeing it even has the audacity to beep and boop at you acting all clueless, you let out a sigh.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Everything has risks. Just tell me straight—what's in it for me, what could go wrong, and... how sure you are you can handle it.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: As long as you remain as rational as you are now, 96.9% of the risks can be mitigated, and you'll have a 100% chance of uncovering the secrets you want about that Sinner—the most authentic, undisguised secrets.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We'll ensure your safety is monitored and protected at every stage, and none of the intelligence you gather will be overlooked. After all, for us, this is also valuable data that helps perfect the technology.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I admire your bravery. EDGE-02 will be deeply grateful.
As suspected, someone new is pulling the strings now. EDGE-02... you make a mental note of this name.

Jasmine lies still on the bed, her expression serene as if a silent defiance against the restraints coiled around her limbs. At the sound of your footsteps, her eyelids flutter open, and her gaze meets yours.

Not long ago, you were both in the interrogation room engaging in a verbal dance of evasion, wasting time circling around each other. Now, she looks at you with the most friendly, innocent smile, as if that battle of wits had never happened.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Chief, right? You finally came to see me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yeah. I just tried to get your blades back for you, but I failed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They said those blades might not be completely safe, so for the sake of your health, they need more time to look into the problem.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Ah, I see... I've never left them behind. It feels a bit strange...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Actually, there's another option—if you could get better, that solves all problems. I've had experts put together a few treatments to speed up your recovery. Want to give them a try?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll go with you, and stay by your side the whole time. You've got nothing to be afraid of.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: I see. I trust you. Many people say you're a good person—a very good person, actually.
She takes your hand and gently rubs her cheek against your palm.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Then... help me, please.
(Scene Change: Laboratory)
Jasmine enters a transparent glass chamber and settles inside in silence. Every so often, her gaze meets yours, lips curving into a faint smile.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The inhibitor will prevent mental instability during the linking process, and the restraints are to prevent her from harming others in case of mental breakdown.
The transparent mental solution begins to flow in until she is completely submerged.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief, please try your best to keep the shackles' connection firm and tight while staying vigilant.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: What you're stepping into is a fractured, chaotic mindscape. The danger level depends on how much this Sinner has endured, and how deep their corruption runs.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Well then, I wish you both a safe journey.
You cast your gaze at Jasmine.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Yeah.
(Check if there's a transition effect that can be added here; if not, use a slow fade to black)
The world shatters before your eyes, plunging you into darkness, only to release you moments later, as abruptly as you fell.
Flames suddenly erupt, illuminating everything around you. The raging fires of war, accompanied by the acrid stench of charred flesh and spilled blood.
A silhouette slowly walks toward you.

No, it's not just one person. They don't answer you, but instead raise their hands. The glint of steel in their grip catches your eye: blades and axes—weapons honed for slaughter, more distinct than the faces of these "people" themselves.
Roaring, they charge toward you—
